text:
Mike: Heads-up — sales intake from Vartha Bank. They want us to onboard cormorant-14b (open) and pin a quantized variant to IN for a 6-week pilot.

Ravi: main requirements?

Mike: 1) Region pin to IN for data residency; 2) quantized variant (target INT8/FP8-like) to hit latency/cost; 3) SLO p95 <300ms for short prompts (~256 tokens); 4) starting capacity ~20 qps; 5) pilot kickoff in ~6 weeks.

Julia: license check? They sent this link: https://github.com/fastmodels/cormorant

Emily: I skimmed — license looks permissive but need to verify weights distribution for quantization. Also request a model card + domain eval set from the customer to validate safety/factuality.

Darrin: runtime flags — 14B dense should be OK with our kernels but quant path needs testing. Continuous batching & KV cache tuning for 256-token bursts. Do we have quant kernels verified on IN GPUs?

Anya: context — Vartha is a mid-enterprise fintech. Sales says high priority but no signed enterprise contract yet. Recommend P2 intake; fast-track to P1 if they sign a commit/Dedicated.

Ravi: security asks — audit logs + customer KMS/EKM. Do they require Private?

Mike: customer prefers hosted in IN with KMS integration, not on-prem.

Emily: ask them to provide a 2k-sample eval set (representative prompts). Target metrics: factual accuracy >=92% on domain tests, hallucination <5% on safety checks, latency p95 <300ms. Also need a list of allowed/forbidden behaviors.

Darrin: immediate tech blockers I see:
- verify quant kernels on IN fleet GPUs
- memory estimate for quantized 14B under 20 qps concurrency
- routing/pinning policy validation so requests don't leak to other regions

Julia: support deliverables — runbook for degraded perf, fallback variant (7B), and a canary rollout plan with clear rollback thresholds.

Anya: proposed acceptance criteria to create the backlog ticket: 
- add model artifacts to catalog (license, model card, weights link)
- quantized variant validated E2E on IN staging (perf matrix: p50/p95 latency, throughput)
- correctness/regression evals with customer samples
- region pin enforced and tested
- KMS integration + audit logs confirmed
- rollout playbook, canary steps, rollback criteria documented

Ravi: rough effort estimate: Eng-ML ~2w for quant + eval harness; Eng-Runtime ~1.5w for kernel verification & routing; Infra ~1w for capacity config. Total ~4w if no kernel rewrites.

Emily: add time for customer to deliver eval set — ask sales to prioritize. Also need small regression prompt set for CI.

Mike: I'll ask Vartha to sign a data share + confirm KMS provider and SLA. I'll try to get LOI to bump priority.

Anya: immediate next actions: 
- Mike: collect eval set, KMS details, confirm SLAs with customer (by EOD Tue)
- Emily: run quant spike on IN GPU (3d)
- Darrin: check kernel coverage + routing pin test (3d)
- Julia: draft support runbook template for catalog onboarding (EOW)

DeployBot: created ticket PROD-4521 for cormorant-14b IN pin + quant onboarding. Assigned to Emily, Darrin.

Emily: will post initial micro-benchmarks to PROD-4521 when ready. :thumbsup:

Mike: looping in legal/security after I confirm license/weights.

Anya: good thread. Keep updates in PROD-4521 and drop quick blockers here. :eyes:
